text: Nations screen reopened scrolled to 'Nations 3-4 of 21' (scroll offset kept from an earlier visit), so the first two rows (neighbours/enemies, the most important) are hidden until Up is pressed; with a settlement the header grows and only 2 rows fit

The settlement's world-space billboard text '0 here, 1/8 residents' (huge grey letters) draws behind/through the settlement sheet title and the Nations screen header, cluttering the top of both panels

Alliance with neighbour Farmshire is a treadmill: gift at tick 2067 -> +10, founding my camp near their border (-10) and border friction took it to -2 by tick 4063; second gift -> +8, by tick ~5400 back to +5; third gift now. Gifts are +10 per 20 s envoy trip but friction is ~-1 per 5 s, so +30 needs ~5 gifts and many minutes. Neither the founding penalty nor the friction rate is shown before acting

Gift to Farmshire took relations to +33 (alliance needs +30), but clicking Ally right after says the envoy is on the road for 20 s; the gift itself spends the envoy, so you must over-gift and then wait while border friction erodes the score before the Ally click is allowed

After 4 gifts (100 coins, ~10 min real) reaching Friendly +33, Ally is declined: 'they are 7 to your 1 and want relations of +60'. The Nations screen header says only 'An alliance needs +30', rows show no strength, so the +60 rule for stronger nations is a hidden requirement discovered only after spending. Every neighbour I had was stronger (1-member nation)
